periods.time: While Stella is recovering after the rescue

name.zh: 福小莉焚毁大教授本体

periods.type: final defeat / assassination of villain core
periods.location: Eilands' true base under Yellowstone National Park, Wyoming
periods.summary: Fu Xiaoli invades Eilands' hidden true base and destroys his enlarged brain before he can seize nuclear weapons to coerce Japan and Vermillion.
periods.cause: Eilands' Japanese body and Stella possession fail, but his true brain survives and he prepares to use Darwin bio-metal backdoors in American weapons, including strategic nuclear missiles, to force Stella's surrender in a future attempt.
periods.process: Xiaoli breaks into the underground cavern on Edelweiss' request. Eilands realizes her League-side identity also makes her a politically convenient executioner, though Xiaoli herself came only out of gratitude. Before he can awaken Abraham guards, Xiaoli uses Shukuchi and Banki's Gohei Taishu with Stella's copied Calusaritio Salamander flame to pierce the brain tank, boil the fluid and expose the giant brain. A second dragon-flame punch incinerates the brain despite Eilands' attempt to grow heat-resistant tissue.
periods.outcome: Eilands' true body is burned to ash in under three minutes. His nuclear coercion plan dies with him, and the League can present his defeat by one of its own fighters as a path toward ceasefire compromise.
casualties: Karl Eilands' true enlarged brain destroyed
Eilands' remaining local base defenses neutralized before activation
periods.significance: Ends the Grand Professor permanently, prevents nuclear escalation, and creates a diplomatic off-ramp by having a League-side fighter defeat the rogue mastermind.
